Eggplant_Blight.suggestion: Early blight detected. Remove infected leaves immediately. Apply copper-based fungicides. Ensure proper spacing between plants for air circulation.
Eggplant_Blight.treatment: Apply fungicide every 7-10 days. Remove severely infected leaves and destroy them. Water at base of plants to avoid wetting foliage.
Eggplant_Blight.prevention: Practice crop rotation. Avoid overhead watering. Maintain proper plant spacing. Apply mulch to prevent soil splash.

Eggplant_Caterpillar.suggestion: Caterpillar infestation detected. Inspect plants regularly and remove caterpillars manually. Consider using organic pesticides.
Eggplant_Caterpillar.treatment: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) spray. Use neem oil solution. Handpick and destroy visible caterpillars.
Eggplant_Caterpillar.prevention: Use pheromone traps. Encourage natural predators like birds and beneficial insects. Cover plants with fine mesh netting.

Eggplant_Hadda_Beetles.suggestion: Hadda beetle infestation detected. These pests can cause significant damage. Remove beetles manually and use neem-based pesticides.
Eggplant_Hadda_Beetles.treatment: Spray neem oil solution weekly. Handpick adults and larvae. Apply insecticidal soap on affected areas.
Eggplant_Hadda_Beetles.prevention: Maintain garden hygiene. Remove plant debris. Use yellow sticky traps. Encourage natural predators.

Eggplant_MagnesiumDeficiency.suggestion: Magnesium deficiency detected. Yellowing between leaf veins is a key symptom. Apply magnesium sulfate (Epsom salt).
Eggplant_MagnesiumDeficiency.treatment: Apply 1 tablespoon Epsom salt per gallon of water. Spray on leaves or apply to soil. Repeat every 2 weeks.
Eggplant_MagnesiumDeficiency.prevention: Maintain soil pH between 6.0-6.8. Use balanced fertilizers. Add compost regularly. Test soil annually.

Eggplant_TMV.suggestion: Tobacco Mosaic Virus detected. This viral disease has no cure. Remove and destroy infected plants immediately.
Eggplant_TMV.treatment: No cure available. Remove infected plants completely. Disinfect tools with bleach solution. Do not compost infected material.
Eggplant_TMV.prevention: Use disease-resistant varieties. Wash hands after handling tobacco. Sterilize tools regularly. Control aphid populations.

Eggplant_Verticillium_Wilt.suggestion: Verticillium wilt detected. This soil-borne fungal disease causes wilting and yellowing. Remove infected plants.
Eggplant_Verticillium_Wilt.treatment: No cure for infected plants. Remove and destroy affected plants. Solarize soil before replanting. Improve soil drainage.
Eggplant_Verticillium_Wilt.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Practice 4-year crop rotation. Avoid planting in previously infected soil. Maintain proper drainage.

Eggplant_healthy.suggestion: Plant is healthy! Continue current care routine with regular watering, fertilization, and pest monitoring.
Eggplant_healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain regular care schedule.
Eggplant_healthy.prevention: Monitor regularly for early disease detection. Maintain proper watering and nutrition. Practice good garden hygiene.

Guava_Caterpillars.suggestion: Caterpillar damage detected on guava. Remove caterpillars manually and apply organic pesticides.
Guava_Caterpillars.treatment: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt). Use neem oil spray. Handpick visible caterpillars in early morning.
Guava_Caterpillars.prevention: Use pheromone traps. Bag individual fruits. Maintain clean orchard. Encourage natural predators.

Guava_Cutting_Weevil.suggestion: Guava weevil infestation detected. Prune and destroy affected shoots. Apply systemic insecticides.
Guava_Cutting_Weevil.treatment: Prune affected shoots 15cm below damage. Apply systemic insecticide. Seal pruning wounds with bordeaux paste.
Guava_Cutting_Weevil.prevention: Regular monitoring and pruning. Destroy pruned material. Apply trunk barriers. Maintain orchard sanitation.

Guava_Die_Back.suggestion: Die-back disease detected. Prune affected branches well below visible symptoms. Apply copper fungicide.
Guava_Die_Back.treatment: Prune 30cm below infected area. Disinfect tools between cuts. Apply copper oxychloride. Paint wounds with bordeaux paste.
Guava_Die_Back.prevention: Avoid mechanical injuries. Improve air circulation through pruning. Apply preventive fungicide sprays. Maintain tree vigor.

Guava_Healthy.suggestion: Guava plant is healthy! Maintain proper watering schedule and balanced nutrition for optimal fruit production.
Guava_Healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular care.
Guava_Healthy.prevention: Regular pruning for air circulation. Monitor for pests and diseases. Apply balanced fertilizer quarterly.

Guava_Mealybug_Pests.suggestion: Mealybug infestation detected. These pests secrete honeydew attracting ants. Use neem oil or insecticidal soap.
Guava_Mealybug_Pests.treatment: Spray neem oil solution weekly. Use cotton swab dipped in alcohol for small infestations. Apply insecticidal soap.
Guava_Mealybug_Pests.prevention: Encourage natural predators like ladybugs. Maintain plant health. Remove heavily infested parts. Control ant populations.

Guava_red_rust.suggestion: Red rust disease detected. This fungal disease causes reddish-brown spots. Apply appropriate fungicide.
Guava_red_rust.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide every 10-14 days. Remove severely infected leaves. Improve air circulation.
Guava_red_rust.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation. Prune for better air flow. Remove fallen leaves. Apply preventive fungicide in wet season.

Guava_yellow_spot.suggestion: Yellow spot disease detected. Remove affected leaves and improve air circulation. Apply fungicide.
Guava_yellow_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves. Apply mancozeb or copper fungicide. Spray at 15-day intervals.
Guava_yellow_spot.prevention: Maintain proper spacing. Prune regularly. Avoid water stress. Apply balanced fertilizer.

Luffa _disease.suggestion: Disease detected in luffa plant. Improve drainage and air circulation. Remove infected parts and apply fungicide.
Luffa _disease.treatment: Remove infected plant parts. Apply appropriate fungicide based on symptoms. Improve soil drainage.
Luffa _disease.prevention: Use disease-free seeds. Practice crop rotation. Maintain proper spacing. Water at base of plants.

Luffa_healthy.suggestion: Luffa plant is healthy! Ensure adequate support for vines and maintain consistent watering.
Luffa_healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Provide sturdy trellis support.
Luffa_healthy.prevention: Maintain consistent moisture. Apply balanced fertilizer. Monitor for pests. Ensure good air circulation.

Rose_Black_Spot.suggestion: Black spot fungal disease detected. Remove infected leaves. Apply fungicide and improve air circulation.
Rose_Black_Spot.treatment: Remove all infected leaves and destroy. Apply systemic fungicide every 7-10 days. Clean up fallen debris.
Rose_Black_Spot.prevention: Water at base only. Space plants properly. Apply preventive fungicide. Choose resistant varieties.

Rose_Healthy_Leaf.suggestion: Rose plant is healthy! Continue proper care with regular deadheading and appropriate fertilization.
Rose_Healthy_Leaf.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue regular maintenance.
Rose_Healthy_Leaf.prevention: Regular deadheading. Balanced fertilization. Proper watering. Annual pruning in late winter.

Rose_Insect_Hole.suggestion: Insect damage detected on rose leaves. Identify the pest and apply appropriate treatment.
Rose_Insect_Hole.treatment: Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil. For severe infestations, use appropriate insecticide. Handpick visible pests.
Rose_Insect_Hole.prevention: Regular inspection. Encourage beneficial insects. Maintain plant health. Remove debris around plants.

Rose_Yellow_Mosaic_Virus.suggestion: Rose mosaic virus detected. No cure available. Remove severely affected plants to prevent spread.
Rose_Yellow_Mosaic_Virus.treatment: No cure available. Remove severely stunted plants. Control aphid vectors. Disinfect pruning tools.
Rose_Yellow_Mosaic_Virus.prevention: Buy certified virus-free plants. Control aphid populations. Sterilize tools. Remove infected plants promptly.

Sweet_Orange_foliage_damaged.suggestion: Foliage damage detected. Could be due to pests, disease, or environmental stress. Inspect closely and treat accordingly.
Sweet_Orange_foliage_damaged.treatment: Identify specific cause. Apply appropriate treatment. Improve cultural practices. Ensure adequate nutrition.
Sweet_Orange_foliage_damaged.prevention: Regular monitoring. Balanced fertilization. Proper irrigation. Maintain tree health through good cultural practices.

Sweet_orange_Healthy.suggestion: Orange tree is healthy! Maintain proper irrigation and fertilization schedule for good fruit production.
Sweet_orange_Healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Continue standard care.
Sweet_orange_Healthy.prevention: Regular fertilization. Adequate watering. Annual pruning. Monitor for pests and diseases.

Sweet_orange_mealybugs.suggestion: Mealybug infestation on orange tree. Use horticultural oil or insecticidal soap. Encourage natural predators.
Sweet_orange_mealybugs.treatment: Apply horticultural oil spray. Use systemic insecticide for severe infestations. Release predatory insects.
Sweet_orange_mealybugs.prevention: Avoid over-fertilizing with nitrogen. Encourage beneficial insects. Regular monitoring. Maintain tree vigor.

Tea_Healthy.suggestion: Tea plant is in good condition. Continue standard maintenance practices for quality leaf production.
Tea_Healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Maintain current care routine.
Tea_Healthy.prevention: Maintain soil pH 4.5-5.5. Regular pruning. Adequate shade. Balanced fertilization.

Tea_algal_leaf.suggestion: Algal leaf spot detected. Improve air circulation and reduce humidity. Apply copper-based fungicide.
Tea_algal_leaf.treatment: Prune to improve air circulation. Apply copper oxychloride. Remove severely affected leaves.
Tea_algal_leaf.prevention: Maintain proper spacing. Prune regularly. Ensure good drainage. Avoid excessive shade.

Tea_gray_blight.suggestion: Gray blight disease detected. Remove infected shoots and apply appropriate fungicide.
Tea_gray_blight.treatment: Prune infected shoots. Apply copper fungicide or bordeaux mixture. Repeat at 15-day intervals.
Tea_gray_blight.prevention: Maintain field hygiene. Proper drainage. Avoid water stress. Apply preventive sprays during monsoon.

Tea_helopeltis.suggestion: Helopeltis (tea mosquito bug) damage detected. Apply systemic insecticides. Monitor regularly.
Tea_helopeltis.treatment: Apply neem-based insecticide or synthetic pyrethroid. Spray early morning or evening. Repeat every 10-15 days.
Tea_helopeltis.prevention: Remove weeds and alternate hosts. Regular monitoring. Apply preventive sprays. Maintain shade regulation.

Tea_looper_infested.suggestion: Tea looper infestation detected. Apply biological or chemical insecticides. Monitor caterpillar population.
Tea_looper_infested.treatment: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt). For severe infestation, use appropriate insecticide. Handpick if feasible.
Tea_looper_infested.prevention: Regular monitoring. Encourage natural predators. Maintain biodiversity. Proper shade management.

Tea_red_spider.suggestion: Red spider mite infestation detected. These pests thrive in hot, dry conditions. Apply miticide.
Tea_red_spider.treatment: Apply appropriate miticide. Use sulfur-based products. Increase humidity around plants. Spray undersides of leaves.
Tea_red_spider.prevention: Maintain adequate moisture. Avoid water stress. Encourage predatory mites. Regular monitoring during dry periods.
